Before You Book

Important Things to Know Before Booking a One-Way Cab

Check Your Route, Fare & Travel Details

Before booking a one-way outstation taxi with Abhi Cabs 24×7, review these details:

  • Pickup & Drop Locations: Confirm your exact starting point and destination.
  • Travel Date & Time: Choose a suitable pickup schedule.
  • One-Way Fare: Review the applicable fare for your selected journey.
  • Toll & Permit Charges: Check whether interstate permits, tolls, and parking charges are included.
  • Driver Allowance: Confirm any applicable driver-related charges.
  • Extra Stops: Check the availability and cost of additional stops.
  • Passengers & Luggage: Select a cab that suits your group size and baggage.
  • Cancellation Policy: Review the booking cancellation and refund conditions.
